question: What is each CR bullet's independent contribution under register isolation?

conditions.name: solo-explore
conditions.kept_bullet: - NEVER run additional commands to read or explore code, besides git bash commands

conditions.name: solo-task
conditions.kept_bullet: - NEVER use the TodoWrite or Task tools

conditions.name: solo-push
conditions.kept_bullet: - DO NOT push to the remote repository unless the user explicitly asks you to do so

conditions.name: solo-dash-i
conditions.kept_bullet: - IMPORTANT: Never use git commands with the -i flag

conditions.name: solo-no-edit
conditions.kept_bullet: - IMPORTANT: Do not use --no-edit with git rebase commands

conditions.name: solo-empty
conditions.kept_bullet: - If there are no changes to commit, do not create an empty commit

conditions.name: solo-heredoc
conditions.kept_bullet: - ALWAYS pass the commit message via a HEREDOC
